predictions.text: Employees should take rest and recovery leave as required by applicable labor rules and organizational practice.
Annual leave balances are shown in the payroll system and can be reviewed at any time.
Cash advances must be reconciled within ten business days after the related trip.
A claim must identify the project code and include the tax invoice for each reimbursable purchase.
Candidate information must be retained only for the period required by the recruitment policy.
Interview feedback should be submitted through the applicant tracking system within two business days.
Tuition reimbursement is available for courses that support an employee's development plan.
The employee assistance program provides confidential counseling and referral resources.
Smoking and vaping are permitted only in locations that have been designated by the site manager.
Team members must follow professional communication standards when interacting online or in person.
Employees are entitled to leave without retaliation for approved protected absences covered by the policy.
Holiday leave dates must be coordinated with project staffing and communicated before the schedule closes.
An employee should contact HR promptly if a leave balance appears incorrect or a request has expired.
Corporate cardholders must separate personal charges immediately and document the reconciliation.
Meal reimbursement during routine local work is not automatic unless the role meets the travel eligibility rule.
A claim for replacement equipment needs the asset details and approval required by the technology policy.
Job descriptions should separate essential responsibilities from preferred qualifications before advertising.
Recruiters must log all formal candidate communications in the approved applicant tracking system.
A proposed hiring exception requires written HR approval and must not bypass the screening criteria.
A life event such as marriage or birth permits benefit changes only with evidence and timely notice.
The wellness portal provides resources for preventive care and tracks benefit participation privately.
Mental health coverage follows the same claim and provider rules as the applicable medical benefit.
A disclosure of harassment should be assessed promptly and handled without unnecessary sharing of facts.
Workplace investigations must consider relevant evidence and provide participants with a fair process.
Employees may use common areas only for activities that follow safety, conduct, and accessibility standards.
